bullets.text: Locals blocked the Chennai Tirupati highway at Kannigaiper in Thiruvallur following a five hour power outage, and the office should monitor power stability.
The personal assistant to the Thiruvallur collector was booked under the POCSO Act in Maduravoyal, and the office should track the legal proceedings.
Police conducted a crackdown on red sanders smuggling from Andhra Pradesh to Tamil Nadu, and the district team should watch enforcement updates.
Police arrested a youth in Thiruvallur for stealing twenty one batteries worth two lakhs using CCTV footage, and the team should review local security.
Crowds rushed to buy six hundred and fifty rupee books at the Thiruvallur Book Fair, and the team should note the successful public turnout.
Dr Rajendra Pratap Gupta stated at GDHS in New Delhi that artificial intelligence is forcing hospitals to transform, and the portfolio team should watch digital healthcare trends.
Mayor Priya accused TVK members of creating a morphed video using AI technology, and the office should monitor political developments surrounding this issue.
